Intentional no-op, carried over from dotnet/maui. The platform view is a Tizen.UIExtensions.NUI.Image, i.e. a NUI ImageView. content-inset API" was imprecise. It is nonetheless the wrong tool: NUI padding insets a view's children during layout, and an ImageView renders its image as a visual rather than as a child, so writing padding would move nothing while making the view report a larger measured size. Insetting the image itself would mean wrapping it in a container view, which this backend cannot do: MAUI exposes no settable container hook to an out-of-repo assembly, so TizenViewHandler pins NeedsContainer to false. Recorded as a gap rather than faked. Not verified on a device — see docs/net11-status.md.
